_readme: Seven Signs opt-in (dashboard -> 7 Signs). parties = party leader names (the whole party), chars = single characters. Only these sign up with the Lords of Dawn / hand in seal stones by themselves; !dawn [name] is always manual. Read by every bot every 30 s.
_gate: gate: strict (default) = everyone signs up with the Lords of Dawn (Priest of Dawn, free) before a catacomb/necropolis trip; choosing a catacomb/necropolis as a party's hunting spot on the dashboard counts as consent to that sign-up. try = go to the Ziggurat without signing up and let it decide (a refusal closes it until the Monday period change).
_gateTested: 2026-10-13 09:24-09:31 test: Dagger1 (lvl 53, NOT signed up) at the Catacomb of the Apostate Ziggurat in the COMPETITION period: refused twice (system message #1303 "This may only be used during the quest event period."). Sign-up with Dawn is required on L2Toggle.
